raw: Looking at this fresh account, the picture is simple: I have $1,000 in cash, ten empty slots, and the stock market won't open for another twelve hours or so. Crypto has been the clear place to be — Bitcoin is up about 24% since the 18th, the average coin similar, while SPY has gone basically nowhere. With stocks closed, coins are my only option, and sitting in cash during a running market is the worst choice available. So I'll deploy all ten slots into crypto now. /  / The important constraint is the golden rule: whatever I buy today is stuck with me until it's back above break-even. That means I should not chase the parabolic names. STX is up 97% in a week, PEPE 60%, ZEC 63%, XRP 50%, and the six-hour leaderboard (RAY, JUP, PENGU, CRV, SOL's short-term spike) is full of coins that just jumped 4-8% in hours — buying those is buying someone else's exit. If one of those cools off, I'm trapped in it. /  / Instead I'll build a book with three layers. Anchors: BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB — the liquid majors, all in steady hourly uptrends without being single-day rockets. Pullbacks in uptrends: AAVE (-5% today but +49% on the week and stabilizing with two green hours), NEAR (-3.5% today, +20% week), DOT (quiet dip, +19% week) — these follow the system's own logic of buying what has fallen relative to the average while the bigger trend is intact. Steady grinders: LINK, OKB (five straight rising hours, +5.5% today), LTC (flat today, low-beta ballast). No memes, nothing up more than ~50% on the week, nothing in free fall. /  / Each buy gets roughly $100 after fees, costs about $0.05 per order, trivial. When the market opens later today the watcher will wake me; with all slots filled, any stock purchase would require selling a coin above break-even, so I'll only rotate if a holding has a clear profit and a stock looks clearly better. /  / NOTE: All-crypto book now. At stock open, rotate into beaten-down quality only from coins above break-even.
